mapper.insert: INSERT INTO semester_time_range (semester, course_create_start, course_create_end, course_select_start, course_select_end, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{semester}, #{courseCreateStart}, #{courseCreateEnd}, #{courseSelectStart}, #{courseSelectEnd}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE semester_time_range SET course_create_start = #{courseCreateStart}, course_create_end = #{courseCreateEnd}, course_select_start = #{courseSelectStart}, course_select_end = #{courseSelectEnd}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE semester = #{semester}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM semester_time_range WHERE semester = ( SELECT CASE WHEN MONTH(NOW()) >= 9 THEN CONCAT(YEAR(NOW()), '-', YEAR(NOW()) + 1, '学年第一学期') ELSE CONCAT(YEAR(NOW()) - 1, '-', YEAR(NOW()), '学年第二学期') END )
SELECT * FROM semester_time_range ORDER BY semester DESC
